name: probandurgy-footprint
question: For each declared Probandurgy mechanism in this project's manifest, is the declared compile-time-presence footprint enforced by an active gate in the build configuration?
cost_provenance: measured 2026-06-12 on the ULDF framework repo under Git Bash (win32; slowest supported environment) -- pessimistic-honest per ORACLE-COST-01; under-declaration causes timeout kills

mechanisms_declared.gate_implementation_found: boolean (true iff every gate_locations[] entry resolves to a parseable, present gate)
mechanisms_declared.gate_locations: array of strings (file#anchor pointers as declared in manifest)
mechanisms_declared.waivers: array of waiver entries from manifest

violations.mechanism: string (mechanism slug, or null when violation is manifest-level)
violations.kind: one of: declared-but-no-gate | gate-location-not-found | waiver-without-rationale-file | manifest-malformed | unsupported-anchor

freshness.comment: Re-runs when manifest changes or when any cited build-config file mutates. Phase 1 verifies gates EXIST; Phase 2 (deferred) verifies gates are EFFECTIVE on built artifacts.

wiring.finalize_phase_11_posture: advisory-only at autopilot; halt at controlled-or-below when violations[] non-empty
wiring.comment: Per FOOTPRINT-04 intake recommendation aligned with DEC-12 Halt Principle conservatism. Phase 11 auto-detects oracles in claude-template/oracles/; no explicit registration required.

fallback: Manually grep the project's build config files for the gates declared in .claude/manifests/probandurgy-footprint.json (Cargo [features], Vite/Webpack/Rollup define, Dockerfile ARG). Then check verifier_script paths with test -f and waiver rationale paths likewise. Slow and error-prone vs. the oracle.

provenance.note: Verification Oracle for the Probandurgy Footprint Discipline (cross-cutting invariant). Phase 1: declared-vs-implemented check. Phase 2 (deferred): per-language artifact inspection. Reference implementation pattern: SessionHelm ARIA-08.

config.comment: Unsupported anchors emit 'gate-location-not-found' violation; oracle never crashes. To add a parser, edit run.sh + run.ps1 and update README's parser support matrix.
